zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.12** 把选区侧栏改成真正发送后才建子会话：打开只准备草稿，关掉未发送的侧栏不会留下空会话，列表会标明来自父会话。
Linux Desktop x64 成为一等 GitHub Release 产物（`.AppImage` / `.deb`），并带 updater 通道文件。
聊天标题栏可以管理全局后台运行；用量面板汇总各通道余额，并显示额度重置倒计时。
Goal 把中断和失败分开：重启后能恢复，失败计划可以重挂，intake 升级时会清掉陈旧中断。
文档站 Changelog 已同步本版说明。

zh.title: 新功能
items: **延迟创建选区子会话**：点「在侧栏打开」只准备草稿；发出第一条消息后才落盘子会话，并在列表显示「来自父会话」。未发送关闭即丢弃。
**Linux x64 桌面包**：GitHub Release 提供 `Peer-Agent-<ver>-x64.AppImage` / `.deb`，以及 `latest-linux.yml` / `beta-linux.yml`。
**全局后台运行**：聊天标题栏集中查看和管理后台任务。
**用量与额度**：统一查看各通道余额；上下文面板显示剩余额度和重置倒计时。
**GPT-6 Astra**：订阅模型目录新增 GPT-6 Astra。
**Skill 安装选工作区**：安装技能时可选择目标工作区，侧栏能看到所有工作区的技能。

zh.title: 优化
items: Goal 面板滚动、探索器生命周期和活动区展示更清楚。
压缩后会刷新上下文占用显示，避免百分比卡住旧值。
SkillHub 安装身份固定到 publisher owner，避免命名空间漂移。
选区子会话横幅贴齐抽屉标题栏。

zh.title: 修复
items: 切会话再回来，Workbench 浏览器页不再整页重载。
侧栏能显示中断中的会话状态。
失败 / 中断的 Goal 计划重挂前会先消费 interruption；intake 升为 accepted_goal 时清掉残留提问态。
Electron 还在 `about:blank` 时不再拉特权设置。
压缩窗口测试与当前 System Context 预算对齐。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: 本 GitHub Release 同时发布 CLI 归档，版本与 Desktop 相同。
一等产物：`peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` / `peer-linux-x64.tar.gz`（内含 `peer` 与 `peer-credential-helper`，**必须同目录**）。
可通过 `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`（或 `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`）安装正式通道版本；`postinstall` 会拉取本版归档。
也可手动解压归档，将目录加入 `PATH`，执行 `peer --version` 校验后运行 `peer`。
CLI 与 Desktop 继续共享 `~/.peer-agent` 下的会话和设置。

en.title: Notes
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.12** delays selection side-chat persistence until the first send: opening the panel only prepares a draft, closing an unsent panel leaves no empty session, and the list shows the parent pointer.
Linux Desktop x64 is now a first-class GitHub Release asset (`.AppImage` / `.deb`) with updater channel files.
The chat header can manage global background runs; the usage panel sums provider balances and shows quota-reset countdown.
Goal distinguishes interruption from failure: plans recover after restart, failed plans can re-arm, and intake upgrades consume stale interruptions.
The docs-site Changelog includes this release.

en.title: What's New
items: **Persist selection children on send**: 「Open in side panel」 prepares a local draft only. The first real send creates the child and shows “From parent” in the list. Closing unsent drafts discards them.
**Linux x64 desktop packages**: GitHub Release ships `Peer-Agent-<ver>-x64.AppImage` / `.deb`, plus `latest-linux.yml` / `beta-linux.yml`.
**Global background runs**: inspect and manage background tasks from the chat header.
**Usage and quota**: unified provider balances; the context panel shows remaining allowance and reset countdown.
**GPT-6 Astra**: subscription catalog includes GPT-6 Astra.
**Skill install workspace picker**: choose the target workspace when installing a skill; the sidebar lists skills from every workspace.

en.title: Improvements
items: Goal panel scrolling, explorer lifecycle, and activity UI are clearer.
Compaction invalidates the context occupancy display so percentages do not stick.
SkillHub install identity is pinned to the publisher owner.
The selection-child banner sits flush under the drawer header.

en.title: Fixes
items: Switching conversations no longer reloads Workbench Browser pages from scratch.
The sidebar can show interrupted conversation status.
Failed / interrupted Goal plans consume interruption before re-arming; intake → accepted_goal clears leftover waiting_user.
Preload skips privileged settings sync while Electron is still on `about:blank`.
Compaction fixture window matches the current System Context budget.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: This GitHub Release ships CLI archives under the same tag / version as Desktop.
First-class assets: `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` / `peer-linux-x64.tar.gz` (contains `peer` + `peer-credential-helper`; they **must stay in the same directory**).
Install the stable channel with `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest` (or `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`); `postinstall` downloads this release's archive.
Alternatively, unpack an archive manually, add its directory to `PATH`, run `peer --version`, and then run `peer`.
CLI and Desktop continue to share sessions and settings under `~/.peer-agent`.
